title: Schema Migration Plan
description: Structured output for a database migration plan.

changes.description: List of tables, columns, or indexes being added, modified, or dropped.

is_destructive.description: True if data could be lost (e.g., dropping a column).

requires_downtime.description: True if this migration locks tables for an extended period.

up_script.description: Path to the UP migration script.

down_script.description: Path to the DOWN migration script.
